digest.component_or_area: bridge runner and destructive-repair pause mechanism
propositions: The bridge must execute portably across local shells, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and bare environments through a single packaged Python entrypoint without requiring repository-local runner scripts.
Legacy reconcile workflows and checked-out environments using `rebar reconcile --mode` vocabulary must retain their existing behavior, defaults, exit codes, and messages.
Destructive-repair pause ownership must be provider-neutral and implemented through git-based durable coordination (`refs/reconciler/gate`) without GitHub CLI dependencies.

The repair-pause mechanism must use compare-and-swap semantics with per-invocation repair tokens to safely coordinate pause state across concurrent repair surface calls (fsck --repair, doctor --repair).
GitHub-specific mirror health monitoring and step-summary reporting remain outside bridge execution and unchanged.

All five acceptance criteria regarding runner-neutral bridge child, provider-neutral repair-pause child, legacy compatibility, packaged-core contract, and no-GitHub-CLI proof must be independently verified and closed.
